tips_en: Start with LongHorizon-Harness—its Manage-Execute-Audit loop and explicit task-state reformulation provide a clean architectural idea with striking empirical gains (e.g., 51.8% to 80.7% on WeaveBench), making it broadly useful for anyone building agents. Then read Skill-α, which is highly complementary: its rollback-reward RL approach for generating procedural skills can naturally plug into harnesses like LongHorizon to further boost downstream task performance. SwanTale is more domain-specific (unified speech/audio generation) and can be read independently based on your interest in TTS and audio modeling.
tips_zh: 建议先读 LongHorizon-Harness——其 Manage-Execute-Audit 循环与显式的任务状态重构思路提供了一个清晰的架构范式，且实证提升显著（如 WeaveBench 从 51.8% 提升至 80.7%），对任何在做智能体系统的研究者都有参考价值。紧接着读 Skill-α，它与前者高度互补：基于回滚奖励的强化学习技能生成方法，可自然嵌入类似 LongHorizon 的执行框架，进一步提升下游任务表现。SwanTale 方向更专（统一语音/音频生成），可按对 TTS 与音频建模的兴趣独立阅读。
